# Turnkey Marketing

> Turnkey Marketing is an auto-repair-specific marketing company for independent repair shops. Its team coordinates strategy, campaigns, creative, customer retention, reporting, and vendor support around one plan.

## Primary pages

- [Auto Repair Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/): Overview of Turnkey's coordinated marketing approach for independent auto repair shops.
- [Auto Repair Marketing Services](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services): The full service lineup and links to detailed service pages.
- [Client Results](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/results): Stories and outcomes from independent auto repair shops.
- [About Turnkey](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/about): The company's team, experience, and approach.
- [Contact Turnkey](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/contact): Ways to contact the team and schedule a consultation.

## Services

- [VIP Marketing Manager](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/vip-marketing-manager): A coordinated outside marketing department for an auto repair shop.
- [DirectTrack Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/directtrack-marketing): Targeted digital acquisition campaigns with ROI tracking and reporting.
- [Marketing Consulting](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/marketing-consulting): Monthly strategy, campaign review, and marketing guidance.
- [Direct Mail](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/direct-mail): Managed postcard campaigns, from design and list strategy through reporting.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/social-media-marketing): Facebook, Instagram, and Google Business Profile content and response support.
- [Retention Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/retention-marketing): Email newsletters, thank-you notes, and CRM follow-up for current customers.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/digital-marketing): Google review management, Business Profile optimization, website audits, and vendor coordination.
- [Boost Days](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/services/boost-days): Focused campaigns for slow periods, open bays, or timing-sensitive demand.

## Who we help

- [European Auto Repair Shops](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/who-we-help/european-auto-repair-shops): Marketing guidance and services for independent European specialists competing on expertise, trust, customer fit, and repair-order quality.
- [Multi-Location Auto Repair Shops](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/who-we-help/multi-location-auto-repair-shops): A coordinated marketing approach for ownership groups that need one central plan and clear location-level demand, reputation, vendor, and reporting decisions.

## Resources

- [Auto Repair Marketing Resources](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources): Practical articles, guides, and tools for independent repair shop owners.

### Planning and strategy

- [How to Build an Auto Repair Marketing Plan](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/auto-repair-marketing-plan): A seven-step guide covering shop goals, ideal customers, budget, channel roles, a 12-month calendar, and performance metrics.
- [Auto Repair Marketing Ideas for the Problem in Front of You](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/auto-repair-marketing-ideas): Marketing ideas organized by the job they need to do, from attracting better-fit customers to filling slow bays and bringing past customers back.
- [Auto Repair Advertising: One Plan for Every Channel](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/auto-repair-advertising): How to give each advertising channel a clear role, oversee vendors, strengthen offers, and measure from calls to repair orders.
- [How to Build an Ideal Customer Profile for Your Repair Shop](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/ideal-customer-profile-auto-repair-shop): How to define the customers a shop wants more of and turn that profile into clearer offers, content, and campaigns.
- [Why Auto Repair Marketing Breaks Down](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/why-auto-repair-marketing-breaks): How to find the stage where customers drop out, from mixed messages and vendor reports to phone calls and capacity, and how to reconnect the system.
- [5 Marketing Mistakes Shop Owners Make and How to Fix Them](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/5-marketing-mistakes-shop-owners-make): Five common marketing mistakes, covering stop-start timing, generic messaging, separate vendor reports, lost calls, and forgotten past customers, with a practical fix for each.

### Reputation, reviews, and AI search

- [Reputation Management for Auto Repair Shops: A Practical Guide](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/auto-repair-reputation-management): How to build honest review requests, thoughtful replies, customer follow-up, and marketing around strengths the team can deliver.
- [Will AI Recommend Your Auto Repair Shop?](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/ai-search-for-auto-repair-shops): How AI search may compare repair shops, what Google's automated calls to businesses mean, and practical steps to become easier to recommend.
- [How to Use AI to Analyze Your Auto Repair Shop's Google Reviews](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/analyze-google-reviews-with-ai): A step-by-step method and reusable prompt for finding patterns in Google reviews, fixing recurring problems, and building marketing around what customers value.

### Channels and messaging

- [Direct Mail for Auto Repair Shops: A Campaign Guide](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/direct-mail-for-repair-shops): How to plan the mailing list, offer, timing, postcard creative, call tracking, and follow-up for a repair shop direct mail campaign.
- [Make Your Repair Shop the Guide in Your Customer's Story](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/be-the-guide-auto-repair-shop-messaging): How to write shop messaging that makes the customer the hero and the shop the trusted guide.
- [The Know-Like-Trust Filter for Repair Shop Marketing](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/know-like-trust-marketing-filter): A checklist for reviewing a shop's website, ads, mail, email, and social content before asking customers to book.
- [The Auto Repair Shop Photography Guide](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/auto-repair-shop-photography-guide): How to plan a shop photo shoot, including preparation, usage rights, and where to use the images.

### Client story

- [The Yearly Marketing Plan Jason Smith Had Never Had](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/resources/jason-smith-marketing-plan): How building a yearly marketing plan with Turnkey changed the way Jason Smith of M&M Car Care Center approached marketing.

### Tools

- [AI Visibility Scan](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/ai-visibility-scan): A free scan showing how clearly AI-powered search understands and recommends a specific auto repair shop.
- [Auto Repair Shop Photo Shot List](https://www.turnkeyautomarketing.com/photos): A photo-day checklist covering the team, customer areas, service bays, repairs, exterior, and community.
